data.name: Cakey & Tanaka : CandyLand Adventure
data.detailed_description:
🍭 A Precious Treat, a New Friend, and an Unexpected Crisis!

One peaceful afternoon, our protagonist Cakey was heading home through the forest with a freshly baked, sweet cupcake from the famous ‘Tanaka Candy Shop.’ Along the way, she discovers a tiny baby squirrel crying all alone in the woods.

Feeling sorry for the poor little thing, Cakey names him ‘Tanaka’ and decides to share her precious cupcake, vowing to become his best friend. But the heartwarming moment is short-lived! Attracted by the irresistibly sweet scent of the cupcake, hungry candy monsters from the forest begin to surround the 두 new friends.

✨ Key Features

  • Dynamic 3D Roguelite Shooting: Build your own combat style with weapon and spell combinations that change every run. Enjoy exhilarating dash actions as you blast through enemies while navigating the vibrant forest.

  • Explosive 'Rapid Fire': In moments of crisis, activate Rapid Fire to boost your attack speed by over 5x! Experience the sheer thrill of clearing a screen full of monsters at once with overwhelming firepower.

  • Strategic Spell & Lock System: Manage your arsenal wisely as weapons have "expiration dates." Use the 'Lock' feature to preserve your core gear and harmoniously strengthen spells for both Cakey (Offense) and Tanaka (Support).

  • Unique Jellybean NPCs: Trade with various Jellybean NPCs scattered throughout the forest! From Cooks and Gamblers to Traders, each offers unique abilities that can either provide a massive boost to your growth—or make your weapons vanish into thin air.

  • Adorable Fairy-tale Visuals: The vibrant colors of CandyLand and charming character illustrations deepen the immersion. But stay sharp—the bosses of this forest are much larger and more powerful than they look!

Can Cakey and Tanaka protect their cupcake from the terrifying candy monsters and make it home safely? The adventure in CandyLand begins now!

data.short_description: Protect the world’s sweetest cupcake! Cakey & Tanaka is a 3D roguelite shooter where you lead a fated duo. If either falls, it’s Game Over! Combine unique spells and unleash Rapid Fire to blast through candy monsters and survive the perils of CandyLand in this high-stakes, sweet adventure.
